Chapter 7004: Repel

Chapter 7004: Repel

In Dusk Realm, immortals returned empty-handed despite visiting the numerous visual phenomena.

Nevertheless, they continued to search this massive world. They were certain that other treasures or remnant parts of Heavenfall awaited them. A single one would be beneficial for a lifetime.

Dusk was a primordial immortal with apex power. Thus, his bones would be useful for other primordial immortals.

As they expanded their search beyond the conspicuous areas, they excavated the land on a wide scale. Nevertheless, some of them held back. Otherwise, immortals could transform the landscape permanently.

Alas, chaos ensued with oceans drying and mountains disappearing. Numerous lives ended tragically, unable to escape in time.

Fortunately, the widescale excavation mainly took place in the wilderness with lower population.

In Fantian Dynasty, Ye Fantian ordered a full evacuation. This included the royal guards and top cultivators in her ancestral ground.

She also knew the celestial source was beneath this place. It was only a matter of time before immortals realized this. Therefore, the most prosperous dynasty in Dusk became vacant in just a short time. Only Ye Fantian, Mo Xiangsheng, and Till Ancestor remained.

“Splash!” On this day, a flood appeared out of nowhere and engulfed her dynasty.

“Seal!” She leaped into the air and attempted to stop the flood. Alas, her technique was repelled.

“Take it in!” Mo Xiangsheng summoned a cauldron, turning it into a world capable of absorbing anything. This was still not enough to stop the flood.

The next wave was monstrous, capable of taking down the stars. Now, it has become more than just drowning the dynasty. This could destroy everything.

The duo activated their supreme dao, using it to stop the wave directly. They thought too highly of themselves and were utterly defeated.

Both vomited blood and fell from the sky like meteors, unable to endure the damage to their dao.

The wave turned into a gigantic palm, continuing its assault. The falling duo naturally understood this was the work of an immortal.

“Bam!” Someone swung a hoe and sent the flood back into the stars.

“Fellow Daoist, show mercy. The young ones don’t know the immensity of heaven and earth.” Till Ancestor spoke coldly while propping the hoe over his shoulder.
